title: Secrets of the Forbidden Grounds
next_chapter_hook: Just as Chen Ji was digesting this string of information, a subtle yet eerie Spiritual Energy fluctuation suddenly came from outside the window—that was the unique aura of the Demonic Path. In the next instant, a familiar black figure swept into the room, Ye Qing's bewitching face flickering in the candlelight: "Young Master Chen, something terrible has happened—the Crown Prince's Grand Preceptor has personally arrived at the Holy Sect."

text.content:
That will was bone-deep cold, as if it could freeze the soul. Chen Ji felt every hair on his body stand on end, the Tianji Record Fragment in his Mental Sea quivering violently, golden runes flickering uncertainly as if issuing some kind of warning. Cold sweat instantly soaked his back; he almost used every ounce of strength to suppress the instinct to flee.

Heaven's Eye—that being which transcended all, was examining him, this ant who dared to peer into Heavenly Secrets.

Chen Ji stared fixedly at the Tianji Record, trying to read something from that will's scrutiny. However, that gaze was too vast, too overwhelming—he felt as if he were an ant at the bottom of a deep sea, able to feel nothing but suffocation.

Just as he was about to collapse, that will suddenly withdrew, receding like the tide. The runes on the fragment returned to calm, but a line of extremely faint gray text had appeared—the mark left by Heaven's Eye.

"Chess... piece..."

dialogue.content: "It has seen you." Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul emerged from the fragment, his tone carrying a rare hint of gravity. "But you're safe for now. Heaven's Eye observes all living beings, yet it does not act lightly—it wants chess pieces, not the lives of ants."

text.content:
Chen Ji slowly exhaled a foul breath, his fingertips trembling slightly. He lowered his head to look at that line of gray text, and his lips suddenly curved into a cold, sharp angle. Chess piece? Fine, then he would be a piece capable of devouring the entire chess game.

"Mo Xiansheng," his voice regained its usual composure, "I need to know more. What exactly is the dragon vein node in the Holy Sect's Forbidden Grounds?"

Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul fell silent for a moment, then spoke hauntingly: "In ancient times, the true dragon fell, and its bloodline merged into the earth, transforming into nine dragon vein nodes. Each node is an eye where the world's spiritual energy gathers, sealing a wisp of the true dragon's remnant will." His voice lowered. "The Holy Sect's Forbidden Grounds is precisely one of the nine nodes—Trapped Dragon Abyss."

The runes on the Tianji Record lit up again, and Chen Ji probed his consciousness into the divination. In an instant, countless images flickered past like a carousel—he saw the Forbidden Grounds deep within the Holy Sect, perpetually shrouded in black mist; he saw the bottomless chasm at the center of the Forbidden Grounds; and he saw the slumbering colossus at the bottom of the abyss... It was a curled dragon shadow, and even as mere remnant spirit, it radiated a terrifying pressure.

Trapped Dragon Abyss... so that was it.

However, what chilled Chen Ji's heart even more was another image. Within the sealing formation of the Trapped Dragon Abyss, he saw a familiar figure—Chen Nian. She was bound by dozens of chains, the chains carved with complex formation patterns, and those patterns... were resonating with the bloodline within her body.

Dragon Vein Key—he finally understood. The reason the Holy Sect went to such lengths to capture Chen Nian was not because she bore the surname Chen, but because she carried the Chen family's ancient bloodline—the bloodline of true dragon descendants, the key to opening or sealing the dragon vein nodes.

dialogue.content: "The Chen family..." Mo Xiansheng's voice suddenly grew complicated. "Do you think where the surname 'Chen' came from? In ancient times, one lineage of the true dragon transformed into mortals, hiding among the world—that is the origin of the Chen family. You and your sister are the only two direct-line descendants among the true dragon bloodline."

text.content:
Chen Ji's hand clenched violently, his fingernails digging deep into his palms. True dragon bloodline? The Chen family actually had such an origin? Then when their parents disappeared, when his sister was kidnapped... none of it was coincidence. From the very beginning, the siblings had been targeted by certain people.

He took a deep breath, forcing himself tocalm下来. Anger was the emotion of the incompetent; what he needed was thought—how to utilize this information.

The Tianji Record's divination continued to deepen. Chen Ji saw that as the Holy Sect deepened the seal on the Trapped Dragon Abyss, Chen Nian's bloodline power within her was being extracted bit by bit—she had been turned into a permanent battery, maintaining the seal's stability with her own life.

And if the seal was completely finished... she would die.

"No." Chen Ji spoke quietly, his voice carrying undeniable resolve. "I must save her."

But Chen Ji was no reckless fool. He stared at the divination images on the Tianji Record, his mind racing. Saving Chen Nian... did not conflict with his feigned death plan. In fact—his eyes suddenly brightened—if operated properly, the two matters could be combined into one.

The Holy Sect sealing the dragon vein would inevitably attract numerous forces with covetous designs. If he caused an "accident" while feigning death, forcing the Holy Sect to open the Forbidden Grounds for inspection... that would be the perfect opportunity to infiltrate.

choice.prompt: Just as Chen Ji was planning his actions, he suddenly sensed something amiss outside the window—that was the unique Spiritual Energy fluctuation of the Demonic Path. How should he respond?

choices.description: Ye Qing has come several times before, and she commands the Demonic Path mist, which is precisely the power he needs most at present. Taking the initiative to make contact can demonstrate sincerity, but it will also expose his alertness.
choices.visible_cost: Expose his whereabouts to Ye Qing
choices.visible_reward: Gain Ye Qing's Demonic Path mist cover
choices.risk_hint: Demonic Path actions are unpredictable; does Ye Qing have other ulterior motives?

text.content: Chen Ji did not hide. Instead, he pushed open the window and spoke calmly: "Miss Ye Qing, visiting so late at night must mean you have important business." Outside the window, a black shadow flickered, and Ye Qing's bewitching face appeared under the moonlight, a flash of surprise in her eyes that quickly turned into a knowing smile. "Young Master Chen is indeed extraordinary. My concealment technique is undetectable by anyone in the Tianqing Sect, yet you saw through it at a glance."

choices.description: First hide his aura to observe the situation; if the visitor harbors ill intentions, strike first. A steady choice, but may miss the opportunity for deeper contact with Ye Qing.
choices.risk_hint: If Ye Qing discovers she is being monitored, she may become wary

text.content: Chen Ji suppressed his aura and merged into the shadows. Moments later, a black shadow swept through the window—it was Ye Qing. She glanced around, brow furrowing: "Strange, I clearly sensed a fluctuation..." Just as she turned, Chen Ji spoke from behind: "Looking for me?" Ye Qing's body stiffened, then she giggled: "Young Master Chen's alertness is far beyond what the rumors call a waste."

choices.description: Consume 5 Heavenly Fate points to foresee the visitor's intentions and potential consequences through the Tianji Record. Know yourself and your enemy, but at the cost of precious Heavenly Fate.
choices.risk_hint: Heavenly Fate is precious and should not be consumed unless absolutely necessary

text.content: Chen Ji quietly activated the Tianji Record, golden runes surfacing in his Mental Sea. Through it, he witnessed Ye Qing bringing shocking news—the Crown Prince's Grand Tutor had arrived at the Holy Sect. He also "saw" the genuine anxiety in her eyes, authentic worry rather than performance. As the divination concluded, Chen Ji had already calculated his response. Five Heavenly Fate points, exchanged for critical intelligence and an ally's sincerity—worth it.

Regardless of Chen Ji's choices, Ye Qing's expression quickly grew solemn. Unlike her usual playful self, she spoke directly: "Young Master Chen, I have urgent matters to tell you." Her voice was low, "The Crown Prince's Grand Tutor of the imperial court... Zhou Yan, the one they call 'Half-Step Sage,' has arrived at the Holy Sect."

dialogue.content: "His cultivation is深不可测, they say he has already stepped half into the realm of sainthood." Ye Qing's eyes flickered with a hint of wariness, "And he brought not just attendants—according to my knowledge, the imperial court has mobilized three Dark Guard units, thirty-six Jindan-stage experts, on standby."

text.content: Chen Ji's brow furrowed. Crown Prince's Grand Tutor Zhou Yan... this name had appeared multiple times in his Tianji Record divinations. This person was the Crown Prince's master and a key figure in the imperial court's covert support of cultivation world forces. His arrival meant the imperial court was determined to obtain the dragon vein node in the Holy Sect's forbidden grounds. "What do they want?" Chen Ji asked in a low voice.

dialogue.content: "The dragon vein." Ye Qing's answer was brief and powerful, "The imperial court has been searching for methods to harness the dragon vein's power. And the seal on the Trapped Dragon Abyss in the Holy Sect... supposedly has loosened." She paused, glancing meaningfully at Chen Ji, "Or rather, someone is deliberately letting it loosen."

text.content: Chen Ji's heart chilled. Ye Qing's words made him consider a terrifying possibility—was someone within the Holy Sect collaborating with the imperial court? Otherwise, why would Chen Nian, this "Heavenly Fate Lock Key," be sent to the Trapped Dragon Abyss? Why would the seal loosen at this precise moment? A name surfaced in his mind—Ling Yuan. The former Sect Master's shadow flashed through his Mental Sea, making his gaze turn ice-cold.

"Young Master Chen seems to have thought of something?" Ye Qing keenly sensed the change in Chen Ji's emotions. Chen Ji did not answer directly, but instead asked: "Miss Ye, who in your view... within the Holy Sect, most wishes the dragon vein seal to loosen?"

choice.prompt: Chen Ji decided to test Ye Qing's stance on the Holy Sect's internal affairs—whether to fully trust or retain some reservations.

choices.text: Honestly disclose the matter of Ling Yuan
choices.description: Directly state your suspicions about Ling Yuan, testing whether Ye Qing knows more. Demonstrates sincerity but also exposes your strategic thinking.
choices.visible_reward: May obtain Ye Qing's intelligence support
choices.risk_hint: If Ye Qing leaks this information, the consequences would be dire

text.content: Chen Ji沉吟片刻，决定冒险一试："夜姑娘，我怀疑......圣宗老掌门凌渊，与皇朝有所勾结。" Ye Qing's eyes flickered with a strange light, then she lowered her voice: "Young Master Chen is indeed perceptive. To be honest, the Demonic Path has also investigated this person—his dealings with the imperial court date back thirty years."

choices.description: Only mention the existence of an insider without naming the specific suspect. Maintain information advantage while giving Ye Qing space to respond.
choices.risk_hint: Ye Qing may consequently hold back

text.content: "Within the Holy Sect... there are probably those who wish to exploit the Dragon Vein's power." Chen Ji's words trailed off, leaving room for interpretation. Ye Qing nodded thoughtfully: "I understand Chen-gongzi's caution. But since we are now allies, I might as well reveal something—the Demonic Path's intelligence network shows that Ling Yuan's frequency of contact with the outside world has increased significantly in recent years."

choices.description: Not revealing his own judgment, but instead asking Ye Qing's view on the Holy Sect's situation, judging her true stance from her answer.
choices.visible_reward: Deeply understanding Ye Qing's true intentions
choices.risk_hint: If seen through by Ye Qing, it may affect the cooperation

text.content: "Ye-guniang, who in the current Holy Sect is most likely colluding with external enemies?" Chen Ji threw the question back. Ye Qing was slightly stunned, then laughed softly: "Chen-gongzi is indeed meticulous. Very well, I won't hide anything—according to my knowledge, three people in the Holy Sect have been secretly communicating with the imperial court: Ling Yuan, Senior Elder Zhou, and... Inner Disciple Senior Fellow Su Qingyao."

Su Qingyao's name made Chen Ji's heart jolt, but his expression remained unchanged. Ye Qing continued: "Of course, Su Qingyao's suspicion is the smallest—her connection with the imperial court is mainly official business, and..." She paused, "According to my knowledge, she has been paying quite some attention to you, even sending people to investigate you."

Chen Ji's lips twitched slightly. Su Qingyao investigating him... that was expected. That woman was terrifyingly sharp, approaching the truth multiple times, all of which he had deflected with various means. Now that Ye Qing mentioned this, he couldn't tell if she was deliberately trying to sow discord or had some other deeper meaning.

"Ye-guniang specifically mentioning this—what are you trying to say?" he asked directly.

Ye Qing's smile faded, her expression turning serious: "What I mean is—Chen-gongzi, your situation is more dangerous than I imagined. The imperial court, the Holy Sect, and possibly the Eye of Heavenly Dao... you are being watched by countless eyes."

dialogue.content: "So I have a proposal." Ye Qing stared directly into Chen Ji's eyes, "You and I cooperate—the Demonic Path provides cover and intelligence, while you handle the arrangements. Once the seal on the Trapped Dragon Abyss loosens, that will be our mutual opportunity." She extended her hand, "How about it?"

text.content:
Chen Ji looked at the hand Ye Qing extended and did not respond immediately. He needed to think—was this woman genuinely seeking cooperation, or did she have ulterior motives? But there was no denying that her proposal was very tempting. The Demonic Path mist could conceal the aura of the Tianji Record, which was what he needed most at the moment.

More importantly... Chen Nian was still waiting for him at the Trapped Dragon Abyss. Regardless of Ye Qing's intentions, he had to make this journey.

choice.prompt: With Ye Qing's cooperation proposal on the table, Chen Ji needed to make a decision. At the same time, the arrival of the Grand Tutor made time even more urgent.

choices.description: Formally ally with Ye Qing, gaining the Demonic Path mist's cover, and jointly plot for the Trapped Dragon Abyss. The advantage is a significant increase in strength; the disadvantage is possibly being drawn deeper into the vortex between the Demonic Path and the Holy Sect.
choices.visible_reward: Gain Demonic Path support and clues about Chen Nian
choices.risk_hint: The Demonic Path acts mysteriously—can Ye Qing be fully trusted?

text.content: Chen Ji extended his hand and lightly clasped Ye Qing's: "Pleasant cooperation." A flash of delight appeared in Ye Qing's eyes, then her usual bewitching smile returned: "Chen-gongzi is indeed straightforward. Then next, we need to formulate a detailed plan—the arrival of the Grand Tutor gives us an excellent opportunity."

choices.description: Accept intelligence exchange but do not engage in deep binding. Maintain freedom of action, but may not receive full support from the Demonic Path mist.
choices.risk_hint: If the plan is leaked, Ye Qing may become a variable

text.content: "Cooperation is acceptable, but I have one condition." Chen Ji said calmly, "During operations, we each take what we need, with no interference in each other's internal affairs." Ye Qing was slightly stunned, then laughed softly: "Chen-gongzi is indeed cautious. Very well, as you wish. However... if one day you need the full assistance of the Demonic Path mist, remember to come find me."

choices.description: Reject Ye Qing's proposal and act alone. Full control over the plan, but lose this crucial aid from the Demonic Path, and may incur Ye Qing's displeasure.
choices.visible_cost: Lose Demonic Path support and intelligence
choices.risk_hint: Face the dual pressure from the Holy Sect and the Imperial Court alone

text.content: Chen Ji slowly shook his head: "I appreciate Ye Qing's kindness, but this matter... I'd like to handle it myself." Ye Qing's smile froze for a moment, then returned to normal: "Chen Gongzi truly stands out from the crowd. Very well, I won't insist—but if you need help, feel free to find me anytime. The waters of Kunlong Gorge run deeper than you imagine."

Regardless of Chen Ji's choice, before leaving, Ye Qing still left one final piece of intelligence: "After Zhou Yan, the Grand Preceptor, arrived at the Holy Sect, his first request was to visit Kunlong Gorge." Her voice carried a hint of amusement, "The Holy Sect's leadership has already agreed—the seal will briefly open at noon tomorrow."

Noon tomorrow... Chen Ji narrowed his eyes. This timing was too convenient. The Grand Preceptor was coming to pay respects to the dragon vein, and he just happened to be planning to rescue Chen Nian. If he could act when the seal opens... "Mister Mo." he called out in his mind, "With the seal briefly opening, what are my odds of sneaking into Kunlong Gorge at my current strength?"

dialogue.content: Mister Mo remained silent for a moment before giving his answer: "Less than thirty percent. The dragon energy in Kunlong Gorge suppresses mortals. Without true dragon bloodline protection, you'll be corroded the moment you enter the depths. Moreover..." His voice grew grave, "Your sister Chen Nian is locked there. Once anyone approaches, her bloodline will resonate, exposing your position."

text.content: Chen Ji fell into deep thought. Thirty percent... too low. But what if he could create chaos when the seal opens, drawing attention away? The Grand Preceptor, various factions, Holy Sect experts... at that time, everyone's attention would be focused elsewhere, and he might have a chance to slip in. Besides, there was still Ye Qing as a variable. Whether he had politely refused or accepted her cooperation, the Demonic Path's style was always to act uninvited—perhaps she was already scheming something in the shadows.

He looked up at the window. The night had deepened, stars scattered thinly. Tomorrow at noon, the Grand Preceptor would visit Kunlong Gorge—this would be the first time in a hundred years the seal would open. Countless factions would have their eyes on this place, and what he needed to do was complete an seemingly impossible rescue amid all this attention. Chen Nian... wait for me. This time, I won't let anyone take you away from me again.

Just as Chen Ji was digesting this barrage of information, a subtle yet eerie Spiritual Energy fluctuation suddenly came through the window—that was a unique aura of the Demonic Path. The next moment, a familiar black shadow swept into the room, Ye Qing's bewitching face flickering in the candlelight: "Chen Gongzi, great trouble has arisen—Zhou Yan, the Grand Preceptor, has personally arrived at the Holy Sect!"
